verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies bulk ingestion: docs describe pushing existing data from a primary database or CSV/JSON file into Typesense, and the Cloud MCP server lets an agent index data from a conversation. No bulk import, update or delete API is explicitly documented. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented batch import endpoint, bulk update/delete-by-filter operations, details on batch sizes and error handling, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
